summary: All 35 registered nursed piglets matched their GEO expression columns. HypoExplorer estimates one sex-adjusted MIA-versus-control effect. The authors report control versus MIA separately for nursed males and females across 11 selected genes, and the companion methylation study supplies no documented RNA estimate for the registered contrast. No concordance score or verification sign-off was proposed. [Published figure source data](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0292952.s005)
openIssues: Reopen if the authors supply a nursed, across-sex RNA estimate with its contrast definition and GSM/SRX inclusion list. The paper reports 72 piglets in balanced design groups, while GEO contains 73 libraries in unequal groups.
All 53 retained downloads passed SHA-256 and byte-length checks. The evidence folder is present locally and excluded by the repository’s Git ignore settings.
